about_the_game:
Welcome to Hollowstride, a voxel sandbox world where your journey is just beginning.

Inspired by the classics but forging its own path, Hollowstride is built with a focus on multiplayer, procedural generation, and moddability. Whether you're building a peaceful village with friends or carving through the wilderness alone, the world is yours to shape.

Key Features

  • Procedurally Generated World
    Every new world is unique. Landscapes form naturally with mountains, caves, valleys, and more—no two worlds are the same.

  • Multiplayer Ready
    Play solo or with friends. Host your own world or join others in shared survival and creativity.

  • Modding Support
    Built with customization in mind. Add your own blocks, items, loot and textures. Or create your own world generators.

  • A Growing Sandbox
    Hollowstride is launching in very early access. Expect bugs, missing features, and a rough edge or two. But also expect transparency, updates, and a focus on community feedback.
